subject: Cost qualification recap + $/1M targets (pilot)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Nair <samir@carelytics.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cost qualification recap + $/1M targets (pilot)

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the run-through this morning. Short recap and explicit asks so we can move to a priced pilot proposal.

Call highlights (as we heard them)
- Expected steady-state inference: 50–150M tokens/month depending on onboarding cadence.
- Peak burst requirement: up to ~10–15 reqs/s for latency-sensitive inference (95th p50 target ~150–250ms).
- Current finance target for MVP: ~$20k–$30k/month cash outlay; flexible if we can show unit economics < $700 per 1M tokens with committable volume.
- Primary concern: predictable per-token unit cost and 99th percentile latency guarantees for routing.

Initial benchmarking context (rough numbers for comparison; will send spreadsheet)
- OpenAI (public chat endpoints): ~ $1,200 / 1M tokens (model & rate dependent) — reference only.
- Anthropic (instant class): ~ $900 / 1M tokens.
- Typical managed open-hosts (quantized model variants): range $400–$750 / 1M tokens depending on model and latency SLO.

Our ask for Carelytics pilot
- Target price band: $550 — $700 per 1M tokens (preferred target: $650 / 1M).
- Pilot proposal: 3-month pilot, staged ramp to 50M tokens/mo month 2, and 120M tokens/mo by month 3, with a commitment-based discount schedule.

Next steps
1) I'll share a pricing slate and side-by-side open-host vs. cloud-host comparison (attached).
2) Samir: confirm your minimum committed monthly spend you can sign today (baseline) and whether you can share a short sample prompt set for us to run latency/quality benchmarks.
3) Internal: Laura/Sergio, please prepare a price-model-slate.xlsx and a quick open-host throughput / 95p latency matrix for the sample prompt set.

Attachments: price-model-slate.xlsx (pricing template), openhost-comparison-sheet.csv (host price comps)

Thanks — talk soon,
Karthik

On Mon, Aug 30, 2027 at 09:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samir —
> 
> Thanks for the run-through this morning. Short recap and explicit asks so we can move to a priced pilot proposal.

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers / clarifications from our side: 
- Volume sensitivity: we can commit to a minimum of 50M tokens/month for a 3-month pilot. If pricing is attractive (< $600 / 1M) we can move to a 6-month commit at 120–150M tokens/month.
- Budget: finance is comfortable authorizing ~$20k/month today for the MVP period; they will increase if we can demonstrate cost predictability and SLA-backed latency.
- Latency: 95th/99th p latency is a gating factor. We need to see p95 <= 300ms and p99 <= 800ms for our top-priority routes.
- Procurement touch: angela.procurement@carelytics.ai (procurement lead) — will loop her in when we have a draft commercial.

Can you send the sample prompt set we discussed? I can also share a small production trace (anonymized) to help your benchmarking.

Attachments: sample-prompts.json (small prompt sample)

—Samir

Subject: Internal: pricing proposal + bench asks (Carelytics)

Laura / Sergio —

Following Samir's reply, proposed commercial we should prepare now:
- Pilot pricing: $650 / 1M tokens for months 1–3 (no seat fees).
- Commitment tier: 15% off list at >= 100M committed tokens/month (months 4+), with a 30-day notice for scale changes.
- SLA: target p95 <= 300ms, p99 <= 800ms for routed requests; fallback routing to lower-cost model when latency breaches.
- Billing: monthly in arrears; invoice and net-30 payment terms.

Action items:
- Laura: finalize price-model-slate.xlsx and generate a DocuSign commercial stub (I will review). Include the per-tier math and an example invoice for 50M and 150M.
- Sergio: run the sample-prompts.json at our internal open-host and on Redwoods hosted runtime; capture p50/p95/p99 and average token cost. Produces a quick CSV and a zipped log.

I'll draft a short commercial email to Samir/Angela once we have the benchmark outputs and the draft DocuSign.

Karthik
